items.name: Sentry
items.sends: Sends: Alerts from your Sentry rules; the payment filter keeps the payment ones
items.off: Disconnected. Alerts from Sentry are refused until you connect it again.

items.name: Datadog
items.sends: Sends: Alerts from your Datadog monitors; the payment filter keeps the payment ones
items.off: Disconnected. Alerts from Datadog are refused until you connect it again.

items.name: PagerDuty
items.sends: Sends: Incidents on the services your payment filter lists
items.off: Disconnected. Alerts from PagerDuty are refused until you connect it again.

items.name: Razorpay webhooks
items.sends: Sends: webhook deliveries to your servers that are late or failing
items.off: Switched off. Razorpay will not tell you when it delivers your webhooks late.

items.name: Slack
items.sends: Root causes, approval requests and closing notes, in #razorpay-payments only
items.off: Disconnected. Root causes and approval requests show only on this dashboard.

items.name: Freshdesk
items.sends: Customer tickets about payments, so a complaint can start a payment issue too
